epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to start full stack from >1 hour to <5 minutes
epics.tocConstraintRef: Developer onboarding and local testing constraint
requirements: R1: Add a docker-compose.yml file that starts the full stack
R2: Expose a health-check endpoint for the stack

slices.title: Add docker-compose and health-check endpoint
slices.jtbd: When implementing containerization for this epic, I want to add a docker-compose.yml and expose a health-check endpoint, so that the system can be started locally and verified.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the repository root, When I run docker-compose up, Then the full stack starts successfully.
Given the running stack, When I send a request to the health-check endpoint, Then it returns a 200 OK response.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce local environment setup time from >10 mins to <1 min

epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce outdated material retention from >10% to <1%
requirements: R1: Support updating existing epidemiological materials via the UI
R2: Support deleting existing epidemiological materials via the UI

slices.title: Implement UI for updating and deleting materials
slices.jtbd: When implementing material management for this epic, I want to add update and delete actions to the UI, so that the catalog can be maintained.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an existing material in the UI, When a user edits it, Then the frontend calls the PUT API endpoint and updates the view.
Given an existing material in the UI, When a user deletes it, Then the frontend calls the DELETE API endpoint and removes it from the view.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce time to update material from manual DB edit to <1 min via UI

epics.title: Authentication and Access Control
epics.jtbd: When accessing the knowledge base, I want to authenticate my identity, so that restricted epidemiological protocols and data are protected from unauthorized access.
epics.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce unauthorized access incidents from current to 0
requirements: R1: Block unauthenticated users from accessing the catalog or creating materials
R2: Prompt blocked users to log in

slices.title: Implement authentication block and login prompt
slices.jtbd: When implementing access control for this epic, I want to block unauthenticated users and prompt them to log in, so that restricted data is protected.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given an unauthenticated user, When they attempt to access the catalog or create a material, Then they are blocked from the restricted routes.
Given a blocked access attempt, When the block occurs, Then the user is prompted to log in to authenticate their identity.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Increase the percentage of authorized access to 100%
